goal: Iske baad aap file mein text, numbers aur records ka poora table likh sakenge, overwrite aur append mein se chun sakenge, aur check kar sakenge ke file khuli ya nahi.
warmup: Sochein canteen ka malik register mein roz ki sales likhta hai. Agar woh har subah nayi page shuru kare, to kal ka page uske apne record ke liye kho jata hai. Agar woh kal ki aakhri line ke neeche likhna jari rakhe, to kuch nahi khota. File mein likhna bhi aisa hi hai: saada ofstream nayi page shuru karta hai (mita deta hai), jabke ios::app aakhri line ke neeche likhna jari rakhta hai.
definition: File mein likhne ke liye aap file ke naam ke saath ofstream object banate hain: ofstream out("data.txt");. Agar file maujood nahi to ban jati hai. Agar maujood hai to uska purana content mit jata hai (yeh default mode ios::out hai). Phir aap out par << bilkul waise use karte hain jaise cout par: numbers, text, variables aur endl sab chalte hain. Text file mein sab kuch characters ki shakal mein store hota hai, is liye number 78 do characters 7 aur 8 ban jata hai. Kaam khatam hone par aap out.close() call karte hain. Purana content rakhne aur aakhir mein jodne ke liye file ko ios::app se kholein: ofstream out("data.txt", ios::app);.
howItWorks: Pehla trace dekhein: har << file mein characters jodta hai. Ghaur karein ke program kya NAHI karta: woh aap ke liye spaces ya new lines nahi lagata. Agar aap out << 12 << 34 likhein, to file mein 1234 hoga, ek hi number jura hua. Is liye values ke beech space (ya endl) likhein: out << 12 << " " << 34. Kholne ke baad hamesha if (!out) check karein. Open masalan tab fail hota hai jab folder read-only ho ya naam galat ho. Poora table save karne ke liye structures ke array par for loop chalayein aur har record ki ek line likhein: roll, space, name, space, marks, endl, jaisa teesri example mein hai. Achi aadat yeh hai ke record ek line mein ho aur fields spaces se alag hon, kyunke agla lesson dikhata hai ke >> aisi lines ko kitni aasani se wapas parh leta hai. Yahan har sample mein hum aakhir mein file ko sirf dikhane ke liye wapas parhte hain, taake aap dekh saken ke kya likha gaya.
